false_sell.definition: SELL research labels whose later same-basis return is positive. Not a portfolio order.

statement: Returns use the approximate last 5-minute close on both ends. They are not official closes and not execution P&L. T+n follows the reference store's verified trading sessions. Each sealed session is one observation; overlapping symbols are not independent samples. A horizon with no primary sample is insufficient evidence. Adverse movement is the worst close-to-close change through that horizon, not an intraday drawdown.
